name: history-evidence-coverage
goal: Every indexed page and visual component has retained captures and applicable real source/runtime measurements, with automatic future coverage and honest gaps for blocked historical rebuilds.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The prepared preview indexes ten revisions, none with full records. Registry audit finds 119 visual modules without a required capture state. Source figures exist, but benchmark series omit focused observations.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing loop tests retain focused measurements only in revision details and never assert the history series. Only red/green runs can retain focused captures, so routine or historical collection wrongly requires a fabricated failure. Strengthen the existing loop CLI fixture to cover independent captures and retained series.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed test-only revision 3be9f5506. Immutable red record reproduces the missing focused benchmark series and the absence of independent capture collection; both expected assertions fail.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
